shader_source_reasons.ue_decode: 0 Unreal pak(s): the shaders are Oodle-compressed in their shader code archives (Octopath Traveler 0), decoded by booting the game on the Mac
shader_source_reasons.oodle_packs: 0 Unreal Engine 3 package(s) with Oodle-compressed chunks (Batman: Arkham Knight, its combined shader cache among them), Oodle-compressed: the shader split decodes them with the game's own decoder in the Mac host (dm/host/hle_oodle.c DM_OODLE_SERVE)
shader_source_reasons.ue_legacy: 0 Unreal pak(s) with the shaders inline in the cooked packages (legacy, version 4, UE 4.18: DRAGON QUEST XI S, LZ5, decoded by the game's own decoder in the Mac host, dm/host/hle_oodle.c DM_OODLE_SERVE; version 11 without shader code archives, UE 4.27: OCTOPATH TRAVELER II, Zlib, or with the cooked packages in an IoStore container beside it: Mario & Luigi: Brothership, Oodle): the shader split reads them file by file
shader_source_reasons.glslc_capture: main holds 0 GLSL sources and calls glslcCompile in no module it loads: shaders compiled at run time (Fire Emblem: Three Houses), captured by booting it on the Mac
shader_source_reasons.vk_capture: no SPIR-V file in the RomFS: the game generates its shaders at run time (Super Mario Galaxy), captured by booting it on the Mac
shader_source_reasons.gl_capture: no GLSL source in the RomFS or main: the game puts its shaders together at run time (LÖVE: Balatro), captured by booting it on the Mac
